title: Our Town
text:
Our town has a small park. It is next to the post office. There is a big tree in the park, and children play there after school.

There is also a library on Green Street. It is open every day except Sunday. Many students go there to read books and do homework.

questions.text: What is next to the park?
Why do students probably like the library?
options: It is a good place to study
It is closed on most days

questions.text: What kind of place is the park probably?
options: A place for children to play

vocabulary.definition: a public place with grass and trees
a place where you send and receive letters and parcels
a building where people can borrow and read books
people who learn at a school or university

paragraph_translations: Kasabamızda küçük bir park var. Park postanenin yanında. Parkta büyük bir ağaç var ve çocuklar okuldan sonra orada oynar.
Ayrıca Green Street üzerinde bir kütüphane var. Pazar günü hariç her gün açıktır. Birçok öğrenci orada kitap okumak ve ödev yapmak için gider.
